description: A hub refusal of one human's command batch, as the Shell tells the human (ticket 26/09/23 C10, audit G-P2-3). `messages` is the refusal's canonical MutationMessage array exactly as the hub encodes it (`🌎️hub` `encode_messages`); `null` is an empty payload (an admission or transport refusal). The outcome step grades a region another human's concurrent command touched as `mutation.clamped` and a violated structural constraint as `mutation.invariant` (`🛢️db/🗿️artifact` `grade_conflict_record`). `notice` is the exact notice text per locale; the hub's own English `reason` never appears in it.
